confirmed_mechanisms.finding: Raw pinned D2H records source on the copy stream, waits for the producer stream, submits async copy and retains a host completion event.
release_device normally synchronizes the latest H2D destination event; it does not normally synchronize the D2H host event. defer_h2d_release skips this wait only for a stream-recorded destination.
Mutation preparation synchronizes a pending D2H read before modifying its source; consumer device_storage waits on the H2D event on the current stream and records the consumer stream.
Warmup DeviceTimer.stop synchronizes each end event; captured operator costs and normal asynchronous replay are different measurement conditions.

runtime_sync_review.measured_context: g14/diagnostic-summary.json contains host release_device intervals and device DMA/compute unions for explicit raw/large/codec fixed policies.
unproven_not_claimed: Every release_device blocks on D2H: contradicted by source; normal D2H lifetime already protected asynchronously.
All summed release_device time is removable critical-path delay.
The magnitude or direction of warmup timing error relative to replay has been causally quantified.
An unimplemented deferred-D2H release would necessarily improve throughput.

limitations: Both all-three-run targets unmet; finite search does not establish a global optimum.
Measured60steps/17candidates/180s search budget, not a default40step performance claim.
Synthetic gated/parallel adapters qualify correctness and RNG, not cross-model throughput.
Profiler intervals perturb execution and are not causally recoverable step-time savings.
Native packet counters cover codec inputs, not all offload bytes; no isolated codec speedup claim.
Final full parameter/gradient fingerprints plus all-step probes, not every-step full gradient comparisons.
Fixed-seed per-rank random token minibatch repeated across steps; no real data pipeline or long-run batch-distribution performance validation.
